entries.13f98e596d518731: Its corporate philosophy is "Healthy and beautiful for people and society," and it states that as a healthcare tech company it will transform the medical and healthcare fields through the use of digital technology. It states that it will work to create the "SOKUYAKU Healthcare Economic Zone," in which all actions in people's "healthcare cycle," from pre-illness and prevention through to disease, are completed on "SOKUYAKU," and to expand its services, and that it will build a stable revenue base through new product launches and expanded services for regular members in mail-order health foods and pharmaceuticals.

entries.2336eb2d90dc2e68: The Healthcare Marketing Business, which accounts for the majority of net sales, grew significantly from the prior year, while the two mail-order businesses declined from the prior year, so the group's center of revenue has shifted to sales promotion support and BPO for corporate clients. At "SOKUYAKU," the usage unit price has risen following the price revision of system usage fees in the prior year, and progress is being made in building revenue sources in the corporate area, such as the introduction of "SOKUYAKU Benefit" for corporate clients and its incorporation into school trip plans offered by travel agencies.
